title: Type Conversion - Int to Float
concept: Use `as Float64` to convert an Int to a Float64 so you can do decimal arithmetic.
why: Sometimes you have an Int but need decimal precision. Converting to Float64 enables fractional results.
syntax_ref: value as Float64  →  converts an Int to a Float64
tips: Use `as Float64` before division when you need decimal results
The original Int variable is unchanged — you get a new Float64 value
Converting Int to Float64 is always lossless for reasonable numbers
You only need to convert one operand: `a as Float64 / b` also works
common_mistakes: Forgetting to convert before dividing: `a / b` is integer division
Converting both numbers when you could just convert one
Converting after the division: `(a / b) as Float64` is too late!
